# NPR cash-denomination counter

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/npr-cash-counter/

Count quantities of Nepali rupee notes and coins separately, calculate the exact total and export a cash-count sheet.

## How to use it

1. Enter your own values or choose a supported file.
2. Adjust the options and run the tool.
3. Review the result, then copy, export or save it when available.

## Example

Count two 1000 notes, one 500 note and several small notes and coins without mixing note and coin rows.

## Limits and checks

This is a manual count, not counterfeit detection or bank reconciliation. Uncommon older denominations are optional; their omission from defaults does not mean they are invalid.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
